items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: I remember Jack Lane's on Mardi Gras day... Jack played in that outfit too... no white drummers ever drum like a nigger except Jack. Jack did a beautiful job on those drums of his.

ctx.x: What kind of bands did they have?
I remember Jack Lane's on Mardi Gras day. I don't remember it as Jack Lane's, but I remember it was... How many bands did they have?
It would be just one good jazz band?
